proxy_features.risk_appetite: 100 * (1 - trailing VIX percentile rank), including current source observation, average ties

alignment.select: second most recent nonmissing US source observation strictly before local signal date

signals.risk_easing: 21-session maximum VIX >= 30 AND VIX <= 0.8 * that maximum
signals.risk_break: 21-session minimum VIX <= 15 AND VIX >= 1.5 * that minimum
signals.onset: false-to-true state change, minimum 20 quote sessions since last accepted alert of same rule in same price segment

outcomes.end: last observed close on/before entry date + horizon; maximum 7 calendar days stale
outcomes.barrier_measure: closing prices only, first hit; desired direction versus opposite; none/censored retained

associations.primary: Spearman lagged proxy level/change vs 8-week forward return
also: same-date descriptive risk/price changes, NOT prediction
associations.controls: price-only Ridge versus same rows with proxy features

models.estimator: Ridge with intercept, alpha=1; train-only population standardization
models.train: all rows with fully mature labels before January 1 of each test year
models.primary_metric: paired squared prediction error versus price-only on identical test rows

uncertainty.method: non-circular moving block bootstrap on chronologically ordered eligible daily rows, overlapping labels; same-index paired loss
uncertainty.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within 12 primary market-by-added-model tests; separate 16 primary market-by-proxy Spearman tests
uncertainty.classification: exploratory, correlated markets and current vintage

official_events.universe: all Statement anchor links on Federal Reserve annual historical pages 1996-2020, and FOMC calendars for 2021-2026; store annual fetch failures
official_events.purpose: date/source atlas only; no causal labels, no surprise estimates, no dating minutes to meeting dates

acceptance: all rule-defined confirmed events and open segments retained; no universal reversal claim; all model variants/horizons/periods and failed or insufficient cells saved; no raw vendor market series published
